customPresets: Replace the compaction-basic provider with @missher/dsh-context-manager/engine explicitly. Saved preset overrides take precedence.

runtimeCapabilities.idleMaintenanceSelection: Plugin-owned selection inside Agent.runMaintenance; no Basic selection hook required
runtimeCapabilities.protectedToolPruning: toolResultPruner.supportsProtectedSeqs === true and an open turn in the session log; idle/manual maintenance skips tool-result pruning and retains checkpoint summaries
runtimeCapabilities.durableMetadata: Existing storageDomain schemas plus a plugin-owned pending metadata journal; no session/learning migration
runtimeCapabilities.summaryAbortCommit: Plugin-owned transaction checks AbortSignal immediately before synchronous Session replacement
runtimeCapabilities.storageShutdownDrain: Writable profileContext.dir/.context-manager-recovery journal; Host registerDrain used when available. Custom embedding without profile path requires Host drain.
runtimeCapabilities.journalDurability: Mandatory regular-file fsync on every platform; POSIX directory fsync, Windows published-file O_RDWR fsync after rename. Failure refuses writes; no power-loss or network-filesystem guarantee. Windows ACL inherited from profile.
runtimeCapabilities.workingSet: Automatic recent-history preference plus bounded checkpoint, with whole tool groups, protected instructions and complete pressure validation; custom total caps optional.
runtimeCapabilities.cycleAccounting: context_manager_cycles v1 stores durable request hashes and original-source watermarks. Existing summary/idle schemas remain unchanged.
runtimeCapabilities.historyRead: Optional tools/sessionQuery/sessions: bounded read-only original text lookup in the executing agent session; no vectors or network.
